limits: Temporal precedence in a saved output is not a causal intervention.
Seeds share validation queries; query-seed observations are not independent datasets.

position_conventions.precedence: subject raw position strictly before the divergent product or EOS
position_conventions.premature_eos: valid output is a strict exact prefix of the ordered teacher answer
position_conventions.processed_index: zero-based after valid response self removal and deduplication

scope: Matched validation-output diagnosis; graph labels diagnostic only; no model runs or output repair
